title: Parenting for Grit
coreMove: Hold the line while making it clear the person is not alone at the line.
sourcePressure: Balance high standards with deep support when helping others grow grit.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Thinking grit is produced by harshness, neglect, or unconditional ease.

sourceAnchors.name: Steve Young
sourceAnchors.detail: Young credited strict but loving parents, including a father nicknamed Grit, for helping him persist when he wanted to quit football.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Steve Young’s father held the line, but the line sat inside a home where the child knew he mattered.

sourceAnchors.name: Francesca Martinez
sourceAnchors.detail: The comedian built a career with cerebral palsy and credits a supportive family that encouraged her calling without spoiling her.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Martinez shows the other half of wise parenting: warmth that still expects follow-through.
